text:
maria: Heads-up — planning a blue->green traffic shift for v4.2.1 in the 21:00-21:30 PDT change window tonight. Want to pin reads to v4.2.0 until warmup completes. 

sam: +1. What are our rollback triggers?

maria: Rollback if p95 latency > 20% baseline for 5m OR errors rise > 1% absolute. Also abort if error spike > 500 reqs in a minute.

leo: Can we do a phased ramp? 0 -> 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over ~20m with 5m hold per step.

maria: yep that's the plan. staging health checks look good. We'll use router weights with the new cohort key.

nina: Reminder: pin reads via feature-flag `read_pin=v4.2.0` in prod-config. Write traffic goes to green.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: service=router, change=weight-update, target=green:v4.2.1, initiated_by=maria. Runbook: /runbooks/releases/bluegreen-shift.

sam: who is on-call for rollback? leo?

leo: I'm oncall tonight until 23:00. I'll be ready to flip weights back.

maria: I'll kick off the first 5% at 21:05. Opsbot will monitor latency and errors; please watch traces.

opsbot: Alerting rule attached: `router_shift_monitor`. P95 baseline=120ms. Alert if >144ms for 5m. Errors >1% for 5m triggers pager.

sam: Add a quick smoke curl we can run during each stage:
```
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.prod.example.com/healthz | jq .status
```

maria: operator command to nudge routing (kube-controller):
```
kubectl exec -n infra router-orch -- /bin/sh -c "apply-weight --service=frontend --cohort=green --weight=25"
```

nina: Note: we've pinned redis config for v4.2.1 on small cache until we validate cache hit rate. If hit rate drops >15% consider rollback.

leo: I'll watch APM traces and the rollout dashboard. If I see any p95 drift I'll call `rollback now` and start the drain on green.

maria: ok starting now — initiating 5% at 21:05. Calling out to @eng-sre for visibility. :loud_sound:

deploy-bot: 21:05:15 — weight-update applied: frontend -> green 5%, blue 95%. ChangeId=cb-6612345678.

opsbot: 21:10:20 — metrics stable. p95=122ms (+1.7%), errors=0.6%. Proceed? :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup: go to 25% after 21:10 hold if no regressions.

maria: advancing to 25% now. running preflight checks.

deploy-bot: 21:15:02 — weight-update applied: frontend -> green 25%, blue 75%. ChangeId=cb-6612345678-step2.

opsbot: 21:18:40 — p95=128ms (+6.6%), errors=0.9%, cache hit rate down 4%. within thresholds.

leo: still looks ok from traces. continuing to 50% in 5m.

nina: reminder: release notes updated in Confluence and PR is merged. No schema changes.

maria: advancing to 50% now. tagging this thread with `release:4.2.1`.

deploy-bot: 21:23:55 — weight-update applied: frontend -> green 50%, blue 50%. ChangeId=cb-6612345678-step3.

opsbot: 21:27:10 — p95=160ms (+33%), errors=1.4% -> ALERT threshold breached. Paging leo.

leo: ack, investigating traces. rolling back to blue 100% now.

maria: roll back command issued.

deploy-bot: 21:28:05 — rollback: weight-update applied: frontend -> blue 100%, green 0%. ChangeId=cb-6612345678-rollback.

opsbot: 21:29:30 — metrics recovering. p95 back to 118ms, errors 0.4%.

sam: can we capture a short post-mortem? What differed between staging and prod for sequence length distribution?

nina: adding notes: observed 25% increase in long-tail seqs in prod traffic; quantization path in v4.2.1 regresses for >2048 tokens. Need a fix or a guard.

maria: agreed. we'll hold v4.2.1 and ship a patch that adds a long-seq fallback kernel. Re-schedule new rollout after fix.

leo: filing a quick follow-up ticket and marking this change as aborted in the release board.

maria: thanks everyone. close the change window early. I'll rerun the canary once we've got the fallback. :white_check_mark:
